case.prompt: Attach this workspace file to my draft.
case.setup: Two owned synthetic sessions and bounded synthetic files, real Composio file transport; draft tool execution remains controlled fixture.
case.expected_result: Exact file bytes become a usable owned attachment; another owner cannot read or replace them.
case.holdout: Same name/content in both sessions; known MD5 collision pair with different SHA-256.
case.answer_key: Evaluator-owned assertions and synthetic input manifest frozen before attempt; never inserted into app agent context.
